findings.claim: 10-K 稱各業務面對全球眾多區域性或專業型至大型公私營競爭者；主要競爭因素為技術差異化、產品性能、服務、交期與價格；公司自稱在各主要產品與服務均為重要競爭者，且失去任一合約或客戶不致造成重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: The most significant competitive factors we face are technology differentiation, product performance, service, delivery schedule and price. Brand reputation, service to customers and quality are also important competitive factors for our products and services.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子揭露：運輸冷凍業務有客戶的關係企業生產與公司競爭的貨櫃冷凍機組，另一客戶生產拖車冷凍機組；客戶或競爭者可能引入非傳統商業模式或破壞性技術。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: For example, an affiliate of a customer in our transport refrigeration business produces refrigeration units for shipping containers that compete with our products, and another one of our transport refrigeration customers produces refrigeration units for truck trailers that compete with our refrigeration units.
